records.source: Flower Dance
records.translation: Sayaw ng mga Bulaklak

records.source: I really hate dancing in front of everyone... It's so embarrassing.#$e#Mom makes me do it.$u
records.translation: Talagang ayaw kong sumayaw sa harap ng lahat... Nakakahiya nang husto.#$e#Pinipilit ako ni Nanay.$u

records.source: Ahh... The air smells so sweet with all these flowers.$h
records.translation: Ahh... Kay tamis ng amoy ng hangin dahil sa lahat ng bulaklak na ito.$h

records.source: These springtime dances can be traced back to ancient fertility rituals.#$e#Hey... You should know about this stuff, farmer.
records.translation: Nagmula pa sa mga sinaunang ritwal ng pagkamayabong ang mga sayaw na ito tuwing tagsibol.#$e#Hoy... dapat alam mo ang mga bagay na ito, magsasaka.

records.source: I like dancing, but this one is a little stilted. The old timers really love it, though.
records.translation: Gusto kong sumayaw, pero medyo pormal at pilit ang sayaw na ito. Gustong-gusto naman ito ng matatanda.

records.source: Ugh...
records.translation: Ugh...
records.preserveReason: Nonlexical character vocalization; preserving the source spelling keeps Sebastian’s audible reaction without adding semantic content.

records.source: Oh, hello there. It's nice of you to talk to me.#$b#Spring is almost over... what a shame.
records.translation: Ah, kumusta. Mabait ka at kinausap mo ako.#$b#Malapit nang matapos ang tagsibol... sayang.

records.source: What! How'd you get back here?$u#$b#Don't touch anything.
records.translation: Ano! Paano ka nakapasok dito sa likuran?$u#$b#Huwag kang humawak ng anuman.

records.source: I wish Pierre would spend this time with the family...$s
records.translation: Sana gugulin ni Pierre ang oras na ito kasama ang pamilya...$s

records.source: I'm just enjoying the scenery... hehe.
records.translation: Tinatamasa ko lang ang tanawin... hehe.

records.source: Flowers? I can hardly see them.#$e#It's too bright out here!
records.translation: Mga bulaklak? Halos hindi ko makita ang mga iyon.#$e#Masyadong maliwanag dito sa labas!

records.source: I've been working on these floral arrangements for a week. Do you like them?
records.translation: Isang linggo kong inayos ang mga bulaklak na ito. Gusto mo ba ang mga ito?

records.source: If you'd like to dance with the other young people, you'll need to find a partner.
records.translation: Kung gusto mong sumayaw kasama ang ibang kabataan, kailangan mong humanap ng kapareha.

records.source: I wonder if Emily would dance with me?
records.translation: Sasayaw kaya si Emily kasama ko?

records.source: *gulp*... I'm nervous.$s
records.translation: *lunok*... Kinakabahan ako.$s

records.source: Now this is the life... Huh, kid? Sweet wine, a babbling brook, warm air... Did I mention wine?
records.translation: Ito ang buhay... Ano, bata? Matamis na alak, lagaslas ng batis, mainit na hangin... Nabanggit ko na ba ang alak?

records.source: Whoo... I'm stuffed. Hey, have you tried the red jelly yet?
records.translation: Whoo... Busog na busog ako. Hoy, natikman mo na ba ang pulang halaya?

records.source: I'm practicing my dance moves... It needs to be perfect.#$e#I've been flower queen for the past 5 years and I'm not ready to step off the throne just yet!
records.translation: Sinasanay ko ang mga galaw ko sa sayaw... Kailangang perpekto ito.#$e#Ako ang Reyna ng mga Bulaklak sa nakaraang limang taon at hindi pa ako handang bumaba sa trono!

records.source: Are you going to be dancing today, @?$h
records.translation: Sasayaw ka ba ngayon, @?$h

records.source: This open field... it makes me nervous.#$e#*whisper* Happy thoughts, Kent. Happy Thoughts.
records.translation: Ang malawak na parang na ito... kinakabahan ako rito.#$e#*bulong* Masasayang kaisipan, Kent. Masasayang kaisipan.

records.source: Marnie looks lovely today...
records.translation: Napakaganda ni Marnie ngayon...

records.source: You know what? I admit it... I really like flowers!
records.translation: Alam mo? Aaminin ko... Gustong-gusto ko talaga ang mga bulaklak!

records.source: Hi @. Glad to see you here.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Natutuwa akong makita ka rito.$h

records.source: Mmm... excellent sauce. *slurp*#$e#Ah, this green stuff is spicy! *munch*#$b#*crunch* ...ow.$s
records.translation: Mmm... napakasarap na sarsa. *lagok*#$e#Ah, maanghang ang berdeng bagay na ito! *nguya*#$b#*langutngot* ...aray.$s

records.source: *sigh*... Love is in the air... And I'm still single.$s
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Nasa hangin ang pag-ibig... At wala pa rin akong kasintahan.$s

records.source: I wore my best shirt for the dance... This sort of thing doesn't happen very often!
records.translation: Isinuot ko ang pinakamaganda kong kamiseta para sa sayaw... Hindi madalas mangyari ang ganitong okasyon!

records.source: Frog season is really starting to pick up.
records.translation: Nagsisimula nang dumami ang mga palaka ngayong panahon.

records.source: You say it's raining up above? *gasp*#$e#Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
records.translation: Sabi mo, umuulan sa itaas? *napasinghap*#$e#Ulan... halos alamat lang iyon sa amin. Ang ilan sa amin ay nabubuhay nang hindi iyon nararanasan kailanman.

records.source: You shouldn't be up here.
records.translation: Hindi ka dapat naririto sa itaas.

records.source: I'm working up the courage to ask someone to dance with me.$11
records.translation: Nag-iipon ako ng lakas ng loob para yayain ang isang taong sumayaw kasama ko.$11

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: Some day, I'm going to be the flower queen!
records.translation: Balang araw, magiging Reyna ako ng mga Bulaklak!

records.source: That's not fair... Why can't I be the flower queen?
records.translation: Hindi patas iyan... Bakit hindi ako maaaring maging Reyna ng mga Bulaklak?

records.source: I should've brought my fishing pole.
records.translation: Dapat ay dinala ko ang pamingwit ko.

records.source: The flowers here are nice, but they aren't as colorful as back home!$h#$e#I wonder if I'll ever have to get up there and dance...$u
records.translation: Magaganda ang mga bulaklak dito, pero hindi kasinkulay ng mga nasa amin!$h#$e#Kailangan ko rin kayang pumunta roon at sumayaw balang araw...$u

records.source: We don't have to dance if you don't want to!$1
records.translation: Hindi natin kailangang sumayaw kung ayaw mo!$1

records.source: I could imagine us moving to a spot like this, someday.$h
records.translation: Naiisip kong maaari tayong lumipat sa isang lugar na tulad nito balang araw.$h

records.source: We should go hiking in these woods someday! I bet there's mushrooms...
records.translation: Dapat tayong maglakad-lakad sa mga kagubatang ito balang araw! Siguradong may mga kabute...

records.source: Today is the big day! We'll be the centerpiece of the whole dance!$1
records.translation: Ngayon ang malaking araw! Tayo ang magiging tampok sa buong sayaw!$1

records.source: I didn't practice much beforehand but I'll give it my best for the both of us.$0
records.translation: Hindi ako gaanong nakapagsanay, pero gagawin ko ang buong makakaya ko para sa ating dalawa.$0
